$comment: The only tests allowed to skip without making a `pnpm verify` step `skipped`, by file (globs; the first entry that matches decides). `allowedIn` names the verbs where the skip is allowed, and even there it is refused when the diff owes the entry's `suite` (tooling/verify/obligations.json). A test that skips and is not here makes the step `skipped`. Keep this list short.

skips.reason: Needs its own migrated database and the staged Boat runtime bundle
Needs the staged Boat runtime bundle (and retention a migrated database)
Needs a migrated database and the staged Boat runtime bundle; CI's Runtime proofs job runs it
The pg-boss queue against a real Postgres; CI's Tests job runs it
Queries and transactions against a real, migrated Postgres; CI's Tests job runs them
Smoke-tests a deployed control plane; nothing local stands in for it

gate: the shell under test installed (CI fails instead of skipping)
skips.reason: One case per login shell; a machine without zsh or fish skips that shell's case
